STEP 1 - Scene: A salad bowl (spinach/greens, sliced cucumber, kidney beans, shaved hard cheese such as Parmesan, and pieces of cooked chicken). Photographed from above, roughly top-down, so the bowl appears nearly circular.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White serving bowl, roughly 24 cm diameter (larger than a side plate, similar to a dinner plate). Area = 3.14 x (12)^2 ≈ 452 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed spinach leaves, cucumber slices, kidney/red beans, shaved hard cheese (Parmesan-type), cooked chicken pieces. No visible dressing or oil pool.

STEP 4 - Area (share of bowl, ~80% covered in total):
- Spinach leaves: 30% = 136 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 340 ml x 0.15 = 51 g x 23 kcal/100g = 12 kcal
- Cheese shavings: 15% = 68 cm^2 x 0.4 cm = 27 ml x 0.95 = 26 g x 400 kcal/100g = 104 kcal
- Kidney beans (about 14 beans, ~2 cm each): 10% = 45 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 68 ml x 0.9 = 61 g x 120 kcal/100g = 73 kcal (canned/cooked weight)
- Cooked chicken: 12% = 54 cm^2 x 1 cm = 54 ml x 0.95 = 51 g x 165 kcal/100g = 84 kcal
- Cucumber: 8% = 36 cm^2 x 1 cm = 36 ml x 0.6 = 22 g x 15 kcal/100g = 3 kcal

STEP 5 - Volume: totals above (sum of gross volumes ≈ 0.8 x 452 cm^2 stacked to typical heights) already included per item.

STEP 6 - Grams: 51 + 26 + 61 + 51 + 22 = 211 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: 12 + 104 + 73 + 84 + 3 = 276 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A bowl of this size, mostly covered with greens, cheese, beans and chicken, is plausibly around 200 g and 250–300 kcal. Consistent with the visible amount; no dressing was seen, so no added oil energy is included.
